<div class="card-body">
'''Dark Dissension''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used or Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">陰湿な軋轢（あつれき）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：「悪の協調」か「単独航行」をキャンセルする。

ロスト：能力値＞２の帝国軍が２名、同じ戦闘に参加しているなら、２フォース消費して運命数を２枚引く。合計値を、敵による損耗と合計戦闘力の値から引く（最低でも０より下には下がらない）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Dark-Dissension-PSA-151452846.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍の士官の数は膨大で、階級の浮沈も激しい。彼らの心には、常に他者との競争心や野心がうずまいている。他人を蹴り落とすことが昇進の近道だからだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Underhanded discord (friction).

'''Card text:'''
USED: Cancel Dark Collaboration or Lone Pilot.

LOST: If two Imperials with ability > 2 are taking part in the same battle, use 2 Force to draw two destiny. Subtract the total from opponent's attrition and total power (cannot fall below zero).

'''Lore:'''
The Imperial officer corps is huge, and ranks rise and fall sharply. Their hearts are always seething with rivalry and ambition. Kicking someone else down is the shortcut to promotion.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dark Dissension]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
